user_withdrawal_queued.meaning: a UserWithdrawal operation for the user exists in the _pendingWithdrawals L1 queue after queueWithdrawal

manager_cancel_called.meaning: a MANAGER_ROLE caller invokes cancelWithdrawal on the user's withdrawal request

operator_process_called.meaning: an OPERATOR_ROLE caller invokes processL1Operations which processes the _pendingWithdrawals queue

l1_withdrawal_executed_after_cancel.meaning: the queued L1 withdrawal operation corresponding to the cancelled L2 request is executed by processL1Operations, undelegating HYPE from the L1 validator and transferring it
l1_withdrawal_executed_after_cancel.checkpoint: during processL1Operations after the L2 cancellation

claims.scope: StakingManager withdrawal lifecycle: queueWithdrawal adds an L1 UserWithdrawal operation to _pendingWithdrawals; MANAGER_ROLE cancelWithdrawal refunds kHYPE and records _cancelledWithdrawalAmount; OPERATOR_ROLE processL1Operations later executes queued L1 operations

preconditions.text: A user has locked kHYPE via queueWithdrawal, creating a UserWithdrawal operation in the _pendingWithdrawals queue and a record in _withdrawalRequests.; A role holding MANAGER_ROLE calls cancelWithdrawal on the user's withdrawal request.; A role holding OPERATOR_ROLE calls processL1Operations, which processes operations in the _pendingWithdrawals queue.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: When a withdrawal request is cancelled, the corresponding L1 withdrawal operation must be removed from the _pendingWithdrawals queue so it is not later executed.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Although the withdrawal request on L2 has been cancelled and the user has retrieved their kHYPE, the existing L1 withdrawal operation in the queue will still be executed as long as the OPERATOR_ROLE calls processL1Operations, so HYPE will be undelegated from the L1 validator and transferred as usual.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The cancelled withdrawal's queue entry is still present when processL1Operations runs, as inferred from the stated root cause that cancelWithdrawal does not remove it.
The L1 withdrawal operation executed corresponds to the same withdrawal request that was cancelled on L2.

limitations: No concrete amounts, transaction hashes, or timing of cancellation versus processing are given; symbols are qualitative occurrence flags.
Only the l1_withdrawal_executed_after_l2_cancel impact is formalized; double-processing value imbalance and exchange-rate deviation are handled in separate passes.
